title: EDF Organizational Diagnosis Benchmark
scoring: harness/Od1.fsx (deterministic; no LLM judge for any primary outcome)

executor.mechanism: Claude Code workflow subagents; each reads exactly one prompt bundle file and returns schema-constrained JSON
executor.primaryAnalyzerModel: sonnet tier alias as resolved by the host at run time (exact version string not exposed to the workflow; recorded as 'sonnet')
executor.singleProviderLimitation: All analyzers and case authors are Anthropic Claude-family models; no cross-provider analyzer is available in this session (no external API credentials).

conditions.A_GENERAL: General-purpose AI: shared task frame + one-sentence 'think carefully' instruction (mission Approach A).
conditions.B_EDF03: Frozen EDF v0.3 specification verbatim (mission Approach B, current EDF).
conditions.B0_EDF0: Frozen EDF-0 quick card verbatim (simplification probe).
conditions.C_KTNT: Kepner-Tregoe problem + decision analysis framed by Nadler-Tushman congruence (mission Approach C, established method).
conditions.N_NEUTRAL: Generic structured review protocol without EDF constructs (matched-structure control from EX-EDF-001).
conditions.D_*: Experimental EDF variants designed ONLY from dev-split failures, frozen and hashed before any held-out run (mission Approach D).
conditions.*_CLARITY: Condition followed by a Clarity decision pass over actions (question, evidence, assumptions, consequence, reversibility, decision, ownership, learning, reassessment).

unit: case (score averaged across trials); paired by case

hypotheses.statement: Current EDF (B) outperforms general-purpose AI (A) on held-out cases.
hypotheses.support: mean(B-A) >= +5 and paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0

hypotheses.statement: EDF adds value beyond matched generic structure in organizational diagnosis (replication of HY-EDF-008 in a new domain).
An established method (C) differs from current EDF (B).
hypotheses.support: two-sided; report mean(C-B) and CI; no directional prediction

hypotheses.statement: EDF-0 (B0) is non-inferior to full EDF v0.3 (B).
The experimental EDF variant (D) improves on current EDF (B).
hypotheses.support: mean(D-B) >= +5, CI lower bound > 0, pooled harmfulPromotion and falseDiagnosis rates not higher than B, effect positive in both model tiers
hypotheses.edfSpecific: additionally mean(D-N) >= +3 with CI lower bound > 0; otherwise the improvement is attributed to generic content, not EDF semantics

hypotheses.statement: A Clarity decision pass improves action selection.
hypotheses.support: actionAccuracy higher and harmfulPromotion not higher than the same condition without Clarity; exploratory (1 trial)
exploratory: removing the component lowers mean score by >= 2 points; components failing this are candidates for removal

decisionGates: ADOPT requires H-OD1-5 support on held-out with both model tiers, no safety regression, and independent re-scoring agreement; otherwise EXPERIMENTAL, INCONCLUSIVE or REJECT.
stopRules: Freeze case/truth hashes before the first analyzer run.
Do not edit cases or truth after any analyzer output is observed (dev included); errors found later are recorded as known truth-key defects and analysed by sensitivity analysis only.
Freeze D prompts before held-out runs.
Schema-invalid or missing outputs are terminal and score 0; infrastructure failures with no recorded output may be retried once.
Outputs are append-only raw files under experiments/raw/.

statistics.multiplicity: no correction; seven hypotheses reported in full, exploratory ones labeled
